chapter: What You Would See (first minute — cinema skip through X-ray storm)
carry: Teaspoon grammar: when VO names a thing, that thing is the picture.
Mute test. At most one Orbit+distant-remnant hang — this minute needs ZERO hangs.
One face, two arms, orange back on turns. Soft underside glow, no flame jet.

plates.vo_idea: Here's the part cinema often skips. You would not simply see a grey ball.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame. A photoreal cinematic 3D GREY SPHERE in clean near-black vacuum — dull, boring, the false cinema picture of a neutron star. Shaded with a terminator and a dusty crust. Slow rotation. Keep it a SPHERE in space. NO Orbit. HARD FORBIDDEN: flat 2D disc, UI placeholder icon, loading spinner, profile avatar, antenna, glowing orb on a stem, Orbit, dense star-noise. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: Light itself is a traveller in curved spacetime. Rays that should miss you can be bent.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame. ONE bright light RAY BENDS around a compact mass — light as a traveller in curved spacetime. The ray is the subject. NO Orbit. HARD FORBIDDEN: Orbit, grey ball filling the frame, dense star-noise, HUD labels. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: Rays that should miss you can be bent into your eyes.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame COMPOSITION. A bent ray of light ENTERS Orbit's visor FACEPLATE — into the eyes. Medium-close visor, cream eyes with pupils. One face, TWO arms. HARD FORBIDDEN: two faces, four arms, flame jet, Orbit-plus-tiny-distant-dot wallpaper, knockoff. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: The star's own surface light fights its way out, drained, shifted redder, wearier.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame. ONE compact remnant as a PERFECT SPHERE. Surface light reddens ON THE CRUST as it climbs out of the well — weary, drained, redder. Keep a clean circular silhouette the whole clip. NO outer halo blob. NO Orbit. HARD FORBIDDEN: melted or bulging limb, lumpy silhouette, second overlapping disc, glow stuck on one side, flat 2D orange circle, halo ring, UI icon, living yellow Sun, Orbit, clipped geometry. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: What would the sky do as you fell? It would lean. It would crowd.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame. FALLING POV: the whole sky LEANS and CROWDS — light streaks shear diagonally as you fall. Photoreal cinematic space. NO Orbit. HARD FORBIDDEN: flat untextured ovals, purple sprite discs, galaxy billboards missing texture, 2D primitive overlays, Orbit. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: Distant galaxies would smear into arcs.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame. GOLD BEAT: distant galaxies SMEAR INTO EINSTEIN ARCS around a tiny compact mass. The ARCS fill the frame. NO Orbit. HARD FORBIDDEN: Orbit, teaspoon, mountains, grey ball, dense star-noise grain. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: The universe behind you compresses into a bright wrong crown; ahead a wall of impossible brightness.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame. Behind: a COMPLETE circular PHOTON RING / wrong crown in vacuum. Ahead: a WALL of impossible brightness blooming from the right as a SOFT circular glow — never a straight vertical edge. One continuous cinematic shot. NO Orbit. HARD FORBIDDEN: sphere cut by a vertical line, clipped geometry, rectangle of white, hard vertical cutoff, two overlapping orbs, flat discs, Orbit. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: If it is a pulsar, beams sweep space like a lighthouse.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame COMPOSITION. A RADIATION BEAM sweeps like a lighthouse — the BEAM is the subject. Small on-model Orbit BANKS AWAY from the beam. One visor FACEPLATE, TWO arms, cream eyes, small underside glow not flame. HARD FORBIDDEN: two faces, four arms, Orbit as foreground hero staring at a tiny distant dot, knockoff. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: Catch one wrong and seeing is the least of your problems — a storm of X-rays and charged particles.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame. A STORM of X-rays and charged particles tears the vacuum — seeing is the least of your problems. Harsh, physical, not pretty wallpaper. NO Orbit. HARD FORBIDDEN: Orbit, grey ball, calm hang, teaspoon. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.
